title: Define full indexed animation pose contract
description:
## Summary
Replace the current position-only animation interchange assumption with a deliberately specified full indexed pose contract capable of representing explicit joint rotation, terminal-bone orientation, axial roll/twist, and future animation sampling without encoding Unity world transforms. Keep the existing immutable PosedSkeleton useful for snapshot/interchange semantics where appropriate, but establish the canonical animation representation before clip/sampler work grows.

## Audit provenance
Synthesized from CCANIM-20260908-ROADMAP-4F2C9A71 and the branch peer-review/audit series. Multi-lens review agrees this is an architectural prerequisite rather than a bug fix.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define canonical animation pose space and document creature/actor/bone/world boundaries.
- Define index identity/compatibility semantics and invalid-bone handling.
- Represent explicit position and rotation per bone; terminal orientation and axial roll must not be inferred solely from child position.
- Preserve an immutable snapshot boundary for diagnostics/interchange; do not make existing snapshots mutable.
- Add focused runtime tests for round-trip pose values, skeleton compatibility, malformed length/nonfinite input, and rest-pose equivalence.
- Do not introduce Unity Animator/Avatar or embed locomotion policy.

## Validation
.NET build/tests and diff review are required. Unity PlayMode is required later when the concrete rig application path is migrated, but this task must not claim Unity validation from source-only work.

## Dependencies
TSK-0118, TSK-0133. Coordinate with TSK-0134 for performance implications.

## Scope boundary
This task defines the contract and minimal implementation needed to make it usable. Clip authoring, playback/blending, locomotion/root motion, and performance benchmarking remain separate tasks.
